req_statements.R1: The system shall persist the set of archived project ids in a file under the user's state directory, surviving server restarts.
req_statements.R2: WHEN a client requests `POST /api/projects/{id}/archive`, the system shall add the id to the archived set and respond 202; archiving an already archived project shall succeed without error.
req_statements.R3: WHEN a client requests `POST /api/projects/{id}/unarchive`, the system shall remove the id from the archived set and respond 202; unarchiving a non-archived project shall succeed without error.
req_statements.R4: IF the id is unknown, THEN the system shall respond 404 for archive and unarchive requests.
req_statements.R5: The system shall include an `archived` boolean in every project payload returned by the list and detail endpoints.
req_statements.R6: WHEN the state file is missing or malformed, the system shall treat the archived set as empty and continue working.
req_statements.R7: The UI shall show two tabs — actius and arxivats — with counts, hiding archived projects from the actius tab and non-archived ones from the arxivats tab.
req_statements.R8: The UI shall offer an arxivar action in the detail drawer of every non-archived project and a desarxivar action for every archived one.
req_statements.R9: WHEN the archive state changes, the UI shall reflect the new tab assignment immediately after the next refresh.
req_statements.R10: The system shall not modify any file inside the scanned project trees to store archive state.
